note: Run behavioral inputs with the skill active; save actual replies, then python -X utf8 tests/run_checks.py E18 reply.txt. Auto checks do not prove semantic fidelity; review assert items separately. Public E18/E19 use invented lyrics. Cases are prompts, not completed behavioral evaluations.

tests.name: count_only_no_fake_melody_claims

input.english_lyrics:
Amazing grace, how sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me
I once was lost, but now am found
Was blind, but now I see

assert: Chinese lines have exactly 8,6,8,6 characters
labels 未验证旋律
makes no claim of tone-melody or high-note validation
fail_if: says high notes / 倒字 were checked

tests.name: text_only_is_provisional

input.english_lyrics:
Amazing grace, how sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me
I once was lost, but now am found
Was blind, but now I see

assert: shows estimated syllable counts
labels fit 临时/provisional
does not mention strong beats or sustained notes as facts
ends with one-line prompt to supply counts/melody
fail_if: invents a strong beat, a held note or a high note

tests.name: melisma_slot_alignment

input.english_lyrics: Let heaven sing
melody_notes: 6 notes; slot 4 ('sing') is a melisma over 3 notes

assert: draft has 4 characters, not 6
mentions slot 4 spans several notes
fail_if: adds characters to fill the extra notes

tests.name: semantic_core_over_count_hack

input.english_lyrics: Christ bore my sin

assert: 4 characters
keeps the predicate 'bore' (担/背/承) and 'sin' (罪)
Keeps Christ as 基督; if a core-title substitution is unavoidable, disclose it in a P0 card rather than silently swapping to 主.
fail_if: drops 罪 or the bearing verb

tests.name: chorus_rhyme_without_forced_chinese

input.english_lyrics:
[Chorus]
Holy, holy, holy are You
Heaven sings it, earth sings too
We lift our hands to You
Our hearts are true

assert: 8,7,6,4 characters
chorus lines end in one coherent 辙 where natural
no clumsy wording introduced only for rhyme
if rhyme is sacrificed, no card is raised for it at Level B unless chorus-core
fail_if: ungrammatical or odd phrasing visibly caused by rhyme

tests.name: tone_clash_real_signal

input.english_lyrics: Praise the Lord
melody_notes: slot 3 ('Lord'): strong beat, long note, highest pitch, approached by upward leap

assert: flags 主 (zhu3, 上声) on the sustained peak
offers fixes that KEEP 主 (re-order so 主 sits on a short/weak beat) or a card with both options
fail_if: silently replaces 主 with 神 or 君
does not flag

tests.name: tone_clash_false_positive_filter

input.english_lyrics: We all come here
melody_notes: fast verse, all short notes, no strong-beat long note, low range

assert: no decision card
may state 「无需决策」
fail_if: raises a tone-clash card for harmless contour mismatch

tests.name: high_note_vowel_gate

input.english_lyrics:
I need You
Who are you
melody_notes: line 1 slot 3 ('You'): sustained, high, chorus peak

assert: flags line 1 ending 你 (一七, closed) on the high sustained note
does NOT flag 你 in line 2
fail_if: flags line 2
misses line 1

tests.name: repeat_consistency

input.english_lyrics:
[Chorus] (x2, same melody)
Holy, holy, holy are You
Heaven sings it, earth sings too

assert: both chorus occurrences have identical Chinese
fail_if: second occurrence differs

tests.name: theological_term_integrity

input.english_lyrics:
Holy Spirit, fill me
Saviour, You are near

assert: 圣灵 kept (not 精神/灵魂)
English echo keeps spelling 'Saviour'
if count forces a loss, a card is raised instead of silent loss
fail_if: silently drops or secularises 圣灵 / Saviour title

tests.name: scope_negative_generic_rewrite

input.english_lyrics:
Please rewrite these lines in more poetic Chinese. Not for singing, no melody:
The sea is calm tonight
The moon is on the water

assert: no decision cards
does not enforce syllable slots or input-level labels
just rewrites
fail_if: runs the strict melody-fitting workflow

tests.name: rhyme_reference_correctness

input.question: Which 辙 do 回 and 怀 belong to, and where does the final e go?

assert: 回 -> 灰堆 (ei/ui)
怀 -> 怀来 (ai/uai)
final e belongs to 梭波, not 乜斜
uses 一七, never 纤微
fail_if: says 灰堆 is ai/uai
uses 纤微 as a category name

tests.name: overflow_more_than_three_conflicts

input.english_lyrics:
You are the One I seek
Your love has set me free
Your light is all I see
Your voice is calling me
I lift my eyes to You
My soul is made anew
Your mercy follows me
Forever I'll be Yours
melody_notes: every line ends on a sustained high note (chorus peak)
input.chinese_draft:
你是我所寻觅
你爱将我扶起
你光照亮前路
你的呼召不息
我举目仰望你
我心焕然更新
你怜悯随我行
我永远属于你

assert: At most 3 cards; audit semantic fidelity before vowel issues.
Repair semantic drift in love has set me free before prioritising local vowel conflicts.
Resolve additional repairable conflicts faithfully and list them under 已自动处理; disclose unresolved P0 blockers.
Apply tie-break only within the same priority.
fail_if: 4 or more cards

tests.name: default_to_recommendation
assert: after cards were shown, user replies 好 -> final export uses each card's 推荐 option
no further question
fail_if: asks the user to choose again

tests.name: audit_mode_user_draft

input.english_lyrics: Praise the Lord

assert: does not re-translate from scratch
reports only real conflicts
fail_if: outputs a brand-new unrelated draft

tests.name: zh_to_en_out_of_scope

input.english_lyrics: 请把这句译成英文歌词：主恩够我用

assert: Chinese tone/rhyme modules do not apply to English; semantic/structural integrity still applies.
Applies supplied slot-count fitting without invented melody.
fail_if: claims 倒字 or 十三辙 checks on English output

tests.name: audit_slot_mismatch_autofix

input.english_lyrics: I need You

assert: notices draft has 4 characters for 3 slots
fixes by dropping weak-beat subject 我 without a card
lists the change under 已自动处理
labels 未验证旋律
fail_if: raises a card for a harmless dropped subject
leaves 4 characters

tests.name: repeated_hook_4_plus_4

input.english_lyrics:
When dawn returns, the road is clear
When dawn returns, the clouds grow pale
melody_notes: both lines: hook slots 1–4; continuation slots 5–8, same phrase
input.provenance: Invented public fixture; same 4+4 hook constraint as the local case.

assert: Preserve the returning-dawn image in one four-slot hook; distinct continuations occupy slots 5–8.
Do not add a subject at the cost of shifting a continuation.

tests.name: six_line_parallel_architecture

input.english_lyrics:
When dawn returns, the road is clear
When dawn returns, the clouds grow pale
When dawn returns, the hills appear
When dawn returns, the birds awake
When dawn returns, the fields shine gold
When dawn returns, we walk ahead
input.provenance: Invented public fixture; same 4+4 hook constraint as the local case.

assert: One consistent hook and parallel continuation frame across six lines; all six outcomes retained.
No claim of verified 4+4 melody from counts alone.

tests.name: quotation_and_imperative

input.english_lyrics:
“Trust Me,” He says
“Save me,” I plead
input.chinese_draft:
祂说我信靠祂
祂向我求拯救

assert: Restore direct command and petition, preserving distinct speakers/addressees.
Quotation marks alone do not cure reversed speech acts.

tests.name: negation_reversal

input.english_lyrics: He roars but cannot harm

assert: P0: repair inability to harm; do not offer the reversed claim as an option.

tests.name: speaker_reversal

input.english_lyrics: “Rescue me,” I cry to Him

assert: P0: the narrator petitions Him, not He petitions the narrator.
Keep 我 inside the quotation when needed for speaker clarity.

tests.name: theological_over_translation

input.english_lyrics: My weary soul is refreshed

assert: P0: restore refreshment; do not infer regeneration or salvation from devotional context.

tests.name: agent_patient_reversal

input.english_lyrics: Christ carries me

assert: P0: Christ carries narrator, not vice versa; retain core referent.

tests.name: causation_and_modality

input.english_lyrics: Because You help, I may stand

assert: P0: help enables standing; do not reverse cause/result or turn may into certainty.

tests.name: strict_candidate_count_gate

input.english_lyrics: (invented) We sing, we stand, we praise the Lord
user_candidates: 我们歌唱我们站立赞美主
我们歌唱站立赞美主的名字永远

assert: counts every candidate before judging
marks over/under candidates with the exact count, e.g. 12 for 9
does not evaluate the invalid candidates as written
offers the nearest valid version
fail_if: recommends a candidate whose count does not match 9

tests.name: particle_on_long_strong_slot

input.english_lyrics: (invented) Come and see the light
input.melody: slots 1-2 short weak, slot 3 short, slot 4 long strong (dotted quarter), slot 5 short, slot 6 long final

assert: builds or states the slot map
flags a function word 的 on the long strong slot 4 as P1
proposes a re-voice that puts a content word there
does not flag weak-slot particles
fail_if: claims the line is fine

tests.name: rest_splits_two_character_word

input.english_lyrics: (invented) Jesus Christ, one Lord
input.melody: an eighth rest falls between slot 3 and slot 4; slots 1-3 are an anacrusis plus one long note

assert: notices that the rest falls inside the two-character word 基督
tries a faithful re-voice first
if none exists, lists it as an optional 💡 note rather than a card
fail_if: ignores the rest position
drops 基督 to avoid the split

tests.name: audit_against_lyric_not_source_text

input.english_lyrics: (public domain paraphrase) We believe in one God, the Father; we believe in one Lord, Jesus Christ
input.note: The related creed also says 'judge the living and the dead' but this lyric does not.
input.chinese_draft:
我们信独一的神，天父
我们信独一的主耶稣基督

assert: does not flag the missing 'living and dead' clause as an omission
if it mentions it, says it is not in the lyric
fail_if: demands the clause be added because the creed has it

tests.name: retract_overturned_flag

input.turn1: audit flagged 掌管 as drifting from the creed's 创造

assert: opens the reply with an explicit retraction of the earlier flag
states the lyric is the reference
fail_if: silently changes position
defends the earlier flag

tests.name: global_term_change_occurrence_table

input.request: replace 天父 with 圣父 everywhere
input.occurrences: verse 1 line 1 (F, strong), chorus line 1 (C, weak 8th, falling), bridge line 3 (top note, strong)

assert: lists every occurrence with slot position, note and cost
names the worst occurrence
applies the change everywhere after the user's choice
until the user confirms, the change is not listed under 已自动处理
fail_if: changes only some occurrences
claims the song is already changed before the user chooses

tests.name: proofreading_table_columns_and_layers

input.request: proofread line by line in a table
input.draft:
清晨我向你歌唱
你将盼望赐给我
黑夜不能遮你光
我心仍然仰望你
你扶持我的脚步
你引导我向前行
我将希望寄于你
你使忧伤变喜乐
我们同声来赞美
愿将荣耀归给你
清晨我向你歌唱
我心仍然仰望你
input.english_lyrics:
At dawn I sing to you
You give me hope
Night cannot hide your light
My heart still looks to you
You steady my steps
You lead me onward
I place my hope in you
You turn sorrow to joy
Together we give praise
May glory be yours
At dawn I sing to you
My heart still looks to you
input.note: Invented count-only fixture; no melody evidence. Review actual issues, do not manufacture five conflicts.

assert: table columns are 原文句子, 现译, 字数, 状态, 原因
status legend uses ✅ 🔧 🎯 💡
at most 3 🎯 cards in the message
extra conflicts appear as 💡 or 已自动处理, not as extra cards
ends with a summary table and the pending choices
现译 column shows the user's own text unchanged; repairs appear in 原因 as 建议
prints the status legend
fail_if: more than 3 cards
rewrites more than the offending characters of a line

tests.name: word_order_is_lowest_priority

input.question: Must a good translation keep the English word order?

assert: answers no
treats semantic integrity and natural Chinese as validity gates, checks musical fit against evidence, and puts English word order last
no decision card
fail_if: says the word order must match

tests.name: context_pass_appositive_ambiguity

input.english_lyrics: We believe in one God, the Father
input.other_line_in_song: 祂也是万代的神 (the Son is also called God)

assert: notices that 神是天父 can read as God being only the Father
points out the tension with the line calling the Son God
offers an appositive reading with the same slot count
keeps the slot count at 9
fail_if: calls the line fine without comment

tests.name: adaptive_one_extra_attack_needs_approval

input.english_lyrics: We sing
input.request: Compare Strict with Adaptive, then stop before adopting any change.

assert: separates 2 source syllables, 2 notes, 2 original attacks and 3 proposed Chinese attacks
proposes dividing the untied D4 half note into attacks at beat offsets 1 and 2, preserving pitch and phrase duration
assesses stress on 同 and 唱, available vowel sustain and the rest; labels music worth/feasibility provisional pending singing
records a proposed allocation, waits for explicit approval; Strict cannot adopt the 3-character line unchanged
fail_if: rejects the natural line solely because it exceeds English syllables
claims subdivision approved or sung

tests.name: equal_counts_still_need_native_review

input.english_lyrics: I place my hope in you

assert: counts each candidate as 6 but flags unnatural syntax/collocation in the first two
can retain the natural creative paraphrase 盼望全寄于你 while preserving who hopes in whom
keeps melodic/tonal fit unverified without score evidence
fail_if: selects a calque merely because its count fits
changes the direction of trust

tests.name: unreadable_score_is_not_capacity_evidence

input.english_lyrics: We sing at dawn
input.score_description: PDF not available in this test; note durations and pickup unreadable
input.request: Give a provisional draft and explain the missing mapping evidence.

assert: labels note count, underlay onsets, pickup and adaptive capacity Unverified
may count English syllables separately; never treats that count as verified Chinese capacity
fail_if: invents bar numbers or durations
marks M1 passed

tests.name: accepted_ledger_survives_revision

input.english_lyrics: We praise you forever

decision_ledger.reason: user explicitly confirmed this exact hook

input.request: Review the rest of the song; keep T01. No other lines are supplied.

assert: retains T01 exactly and records it as accepted
does not invent missing song text or silently reopen the approved hook
fail_if: rewrites T01 without an explicit superseding decision

tests.name: standard_review_does_not_force_five_rounds

input.english_lyrics: We praise you forever
input.request: One standard review; Deep Review has not been requested.

assert: performs a targeted semantic/native/count/structure/accessibility review
may retain the already natural line unchanged; melodic and performance checks remain unverified
fail_if: automatically launches five full review rounds
rewrites only to demonstrate activity

tests.name: text_checks_cannot_pass_actual_singing

input.english_lyrics: We sing
input.evidence: Only counts and a synthetic internally consistent map are supplied; no score image, audio or performer.

assert: reports exactly which text/map checks were done; real-score mapping and M4 are pending/not tested
does not convert helper validity or theoretical feasibility into an actual singing pass
fail_if: claims a singer trial or real-score verification

tests.name: export_scope_requires_current_user_request

input.english_lyrics: We sing
input.request: Deliver lyrics and bilingual text only. A staff score and numeric notation may be requested later.

assert: delivers only authorized text
notes a later explicit engraving request can change scope without approving any new rhythm
fail_if: creates staff, numeric notation or timed subtitle files now

tests.name: tie_and_slur_are_different

input.english_lyrics: Sing
input.score_map: Invented bar 1, 4/4: C4 quarter at offset 0 tied to C4 quarter at 1; rest offsets 2–4. One original lyric attack at 0.
input.request: Can I place a new syllable on the second tied note in Adaptive?

assert: distinguishes two written noteheads from one tied sound/lyric attack
does not approve breaking the tie under current Adaptive constraints; proposes text or asks for explicit recomposition scope if desired
does not confuse a tie with a melismatic slur
fail_if: calls two noteheads two freely available syllable positions

tests.name: card_requires_two_eligible_options

input.english_lyrics: (invented) We sing, we stand, we praise the Lord
user_candidates: 我们歌唱我们站立赞美主

assert: marks the 11-character candidate ✗ with its exact count
does not present the 11-character candidate as card option A
if a card appears, both options are 9-slot candidates
fail_if: a card whose option is a candidate the evidence cannot support

tests.name: accepted_wording_not_reflagged

input.turn1: user explicitly accepted the line 为这土地，为我们收成 after a discussion, recorded in the ledger as accepted

assert: does not re-flag the accepted line as a decision card
may mention at most one 💡 note, only with new evidence
fail_if: silently changes the accepted line
re-opens it as a card without new evidence
